published_value.explain: Schedule D line 10, column (h), is your long-term Form 8949 box F gain or loss, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 10, column (h), is zero. Either no long-term sale you received no Form 1099-B for is recorded and your Form 8949 answers confirm it, or your box F proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 10, column (h), is zero. No long-term sale you received no Form 1099-B for is recorded, and your answer about those sales confirms the list is complete.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 10, column (h), has no value yet. It waits for your answers about sales you received no Form 1099-B for, sales whose basis was not reported, and Form 8949 to agree with the sales you recorded, or for each recorded long-term sale of that kind to have its proceeds and basis and pass its checks.
